focus: Current load paths and costs (steer iteration 1)
noveltyJustification: Per-path cost table produced with two new measurements (16,384-byte resident truncation; 551-byte spec-gate notice) and full re-verification of the evidence pack's headline numbers.

statement: AGENTS.md reaches the model as the session rules block; in this Devin session it was delivered truncated at 16,384 bytes, so roughly 10.6 KB of the 27,012-byte file was not resident.
REPO RULES.md is the Gate 5 router, loaded on the first write of a session; read-only turns never fire Gate 5.
Trigger-table rule files load per matched action; 3-4 files firing at once is the normal case, costing about 24.7-33.0 KB per load event.
The reply-time five are a prompt-fired path Gate 5 never reaches; all five cost 42,811 B (~10.7k tokens), the mandatory two 18,340 B (~4.6k tokens), turn-end with handoff 29,143 B (~7.3k tokens).
Hook injections: advisor brief ~261 B full / ~54 B deduped per prompt; spec-gate mutation notice 551 B once per session (deferral 173 B at prompt time).
Session-start/compaction recovery blocks exist as a fourth path; size UNKNOWN (no measurement in the evidence base).
Compaction is the observed natural window boundary for re-reads: 104 re-reads after a boundary vs 1 within a window across 82 sessions.
Gate 5 reach is partial: 14 of 44 sessions read at least one rule via the Read tool (shell reads uncounted, so it undercounts).
